configurations.name: web-dev
runtimeArgs: source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use --silent default && npm run dev --workspace=apps/web

configurations.name: web-dev-testkeys
runtimeArgs: source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use --silent default && NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY=1x00000000000000000000AA TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY=1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL= UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN= npm run dev --workspace=apps/web

configurations.name: admin-dev
runtimeArgs: source "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use --silent default && npm run dev --workspace=apps/admin
